jobs.source:
"""Ion guard. Use the Ion Check settings snapshot; no DAC swap commands."""
from labremote.ion_check import config

def main(devices):
    p=devices.parameters
    c=config.validate(p['settings'],require_thresholds=True)
    return devices.fpga(p.get('fpga','fpga_local')).run_ion_check(
        settings=c,mode='workflow',directory=devices.run_directory or p.get('directory')).wait()
